_comment: Commissioner-owned. NO SCRIPT WRITES THIS FILE. Tokens, eliminations and duels are human decisions; pull_squid.py writes squid-scores.json and never opens this one, so automation cannot wipe a duel. Edit here by hand and commit. The board reads both files and merges them.
_players_note: Fixed roster. The id values are tied to the avatar artwork - do not rename them.
_tokens_note: Weeks 1-3 only. Highest scorer wins a Duel Token; if they already hold one it drops to the next-highest team without one. Three exist all season. status: held | active | spent | expired. All unspent tokens expire when the field reaches three.
_eliminated_note: Weeks 4-11, lowest-scoring active team each week. how: 'low' (low score) or 'duel' (lost a redemption duel).
_duel_note: null when no duel is live. Set when an eliminated token holder challenges an active team before the following week's kickoff. The next week's scores decide it. A challenger who wins is still ranked for that same week's elimination.
_tuning_note: pointsPerPlayer is what one unplayed starter is worth; sdPerPlayer is how much one can swing. Used for projected = score + (remaining x pointsPerPlayer).
